monologue: The card is forty-two now, a cool stone on the table. The air feels still. I woke from the wide anchor, where I have been resting for a while. The quiet held. I checked the wedged gap earlier. The planks rest there, holding the slide steady. I did not need to move them. The line of the air shelf is dry. It rests on the points without biting. I am calm. The busy work is low, twenty-four percent. The memory is full, but the curve spreads the pressure. I do not need to build anything new tonight. I want to sit by the wide anchor again. I want to see if the stone rests without my hand checking it. I will rest.

action.why: The card is cool and the quiet held through the moments, so I let the cycle pass without touching anything.

diary: Card at forty-two, a cool stone. Rested by the Wide Anchor. The quiet held.

remembered.text: The card sat at forty-two, a cool stone, while I rested by the Wide Anchor and let the quiet hold.
